negative_findings.description: Banka Slovenije vacancy application (apl.bsi.si/zaposlitev.asp) returned 'Trenutno ni razpisanih mest' — no open positions at time of scouting.
negative_findings.result_summary: Source is live and correctly structured, but currently carries zero vacancies. This is a real observation, not a failure.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The collector must distinguish 'no vacancies' from 'fetch failed'; the Slovenian empty-state string should be encoded as a recognised sentinel so the central bank is not silently dropped.

negative_findings.description: https://otpbanka.fledgehr.com/jobs (OTP banka's actual vacancy board) could not be retrieved: 'Too many redirects (exceeded 10)'.
negative_findings.result_summary: Almost certainly a cookie/JS-gated single-page app rather than a dead endpoint — the URL is linked directly from otpbanka.si/kariera.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: OTP banka is the #2 SI bank; losing its vacancy feed would be a major coverage hole. Needs a headless-browser or API-level collector, not plain HTTP.

negative_findings.description: https://zaposlitve.unicreditbank.si/ rendered only a logo, a GDPR document link and a footer; the 'Prosta delovna mesta' heading was present but no job records.
negative_findings.result_summary: Client-side rendered portal; ATS vendor could not be identified from the served HTML.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: UniCredit Banka Slovenija's hiring is currently unobservable by simple fetch; the ATS vendor is also unidentified, which is itself a gap in the HR-tech map.

negative_findings.description: https://www.nlb.si/zaposlitev returned HTTP 404, and https://www.skb.si/sl/o-skb/zaposlitev 302-redirects to https://www.otpbanka.si/sl/o-skb/zaposlitev.
negative_findings.result_summary: Careers content for NLB now lives under nlbgroup.com/int-en/careers/...; SKB banka's careers content has been absorbed into otpbanka.si following the SKB/Nova KBM–OTP consolidation.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any pre-existing source list pointing at nlb.si/zaposlitev or skb.si careers is stale. The SKB redirect is itself corroborating evidence of the completed merger and of org consolidation — record it as a signal, not just a broken link.

negative_findings.description: Delavska hranilnica, Dezelna banka Slovenije, Gorenjska banka and Hranilnica LON publish vacancies as plain CMS pages with email-only application (kadrovska@dh.si, kadri@lon.si) — no ATS layer at all.
negative_findings.result_summary: A material share of the SI banking sector has no Workday/SmartRecruiters/Talentlyft footprint; the cell's ATS-platform hypothesis holds only for foreign-owned groups (Cornerstone at NLB, SuccessFactors at Intesa, Erste portal at Sparkasse, FledgeHR at OTP).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection design cannot assume structured ATS feeds; roughly half the actors need bespoke HTML diffing, and Workday/SmartRecruiters/Talentlyft were NOT observed at any Slovenian bank in this pass.

negative_findings.description: Addiko Bank Slovenija's /prosta-delovna-mesta/ page returned culture, process and benefits content but no enumerable job rows.
negative_findings.result_summary: Either the list is JS-injected or the bank had no open roles at that moment; cannot distinguish from a single fetch.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Addiko is an M&A target (NLB bid) — its hiring trajectory is high-value context. Must be re-checked with a rendering fetcher before concluding anything.

negative_findings.description: The seed-style query term 'banka Slovenija' collides with the central bank 'Banka Slovenije' and with generic 'bank in Slovenia'; 'LON' collides with placenames and the English word; 'kariera' returns employer-branding pages rather than vacancy lists.
negative_findings.result_summary: Query design must use exact institution legal names ('Delavska hranilnica d.d.', 'Hranilnica LON d.d., Kranj', 'Dezelna banka Slovenije d.d.') and vacancy-specific terms ('prosta delovna mesta', 'aktualna delovna mesta', 'razpisana mesta', 'zaposlujemo') rather than 'kariera'.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents both false positives and missed vacancy pages in the recurring collection queries.

negative_findings.description: No Slovenian-language equivalent or local vocabulary was found for the ATS product names themselves (Workday, SmartRecruiters, Talentlyft, Cornerstone, FledgeHR) — Slovenian bank career pages use the English product/vendor names or expose no vendor name at all.
negative_findings.result_summary: ATS identification in SI must be done by URL/domain fingerprinting, not by local-language search.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Local-language search cannot map the HR-tech stack here; the collector needs a domain-fingerprint rule set instead.

coverage_gaps.description: This cell's sources surface open ROLES well but capture executive/leadership appointments only incidentally (e.g. DBS 'regijski direktor' vacancy). Board-level and management-board changes are not published as vacancies.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Pair this cell with AJPES/company-register management-board filings, bank press releases and Banka Slovenije fit-and-proper approvals to cover leadership moves; do not rely on career pages for that topic.

coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Snapshot every source into an archive (own store plus Wayback save-page-now) on each poll so hiring volume can be trended, and treat disappearance-without-archive as data loss.

coverage_gaps.description: Commercial aggregators (Optius, MojeDelo, Careerjet, BetterCareer) are the only route to the long tail, but their ToS/robots were not reviewed and are likely to restrict automated collection.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Review robots.txt and ToS for each portal; restrict aggregator use to low-rate actor discovery and gap-filling, and rely on the banks' own pages for bulk collection.

brief: Slovenian bank hiring is published through two clearly separated tiers. Foreign-owned groups route vacancies to group ATS platforms — NLB to Cornerstone OnDemand (nlb.csod.com), Intesa Sanpaolo Bank Slovenija to a SAP SuccessFactors portal with a dedicated Slovenia category, Banka Sparkasse to the Erste Group careers portal, and OTP banka (now absorbing Nova KBM and SKB) to FledgeHR — while domestically owned banks and savings banks (Gorenjska banka, Delavska hranilnica, Dezelna banka Slovenije, Hranilnica LON, Primorska hranilnica Vipava) publish plain dated CMS lists with email-only application, or delegate entirely to the MojeDelo portal as BKS Bank does; Workday, SmartRecruiters and Talentlyft were not observed at any Slovenian bank in this pass. The single highest-value source for this cell's payments/cards/ATM focus is not a bank at all but Bankart d.o.o., the shared processing centre most Slovenian banks outsource card, POS and ATM processing to, alongside Banka Slovenije's separate vacancy application (apl.bsi.si, currently empty) for supervisory capacity. Concrete weak signals were already visible during scouting — Delavska hranilnica hiring into a 'sektor placilnih sistemov' and a data-governance role, Gorenjska banka hiring an RDARR validation specialist and a Windows systems engineer, Intesa Sanpaolo hiring a Digital Channels Specialist for Koper/Ljubljana — confirming the cell's premise. Main residual risks are two unreadable feeds (OTP/FledgeHR redirect loop, UniCredit's JS-rendered portal), the absence of any historical series, and an incomplete actor list that should be closed against the Bank of Slovenia register of authorised credit institutions.
